capabilities: Render Markdown model files as ER, class, DFD, flow, and screen diagrams
Detect relationships and dependencies across the vault for impact analysis
Navigate from design objects to linked source files via Source Links
Validate models with real-time diagnostics in the preview
Export the current diagram as a PNG
disambiguation: Not a diagram-drawing tool; diagrams are generated views, and the Markdown model files remain the source of truth.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later (since 0.1.16). Source Links to files outside the vault are desktop-only and configured via localSourceRoot. Full docs (Getting Started, Command Guide, Format Guide, Roadmap) live outside the README. PNG export captures only the diagram body.
problem: Obsidian has no structured way to keep software design models as text and render them as navigable diagrams with relationship and impact analysis.

relations.evidence: Custom renderers are for detailed review; Mermaid renderers are for overview.

summary: Modeling plugin that treats Markdown design files as the source of truth and renders ER, class, data-flow, and flow diagrams with diagnostics.
